issue.title: PRE/POST checklist glyphs and compact recurrence marks
issue.description: In Obsidian, a canonical `#task #gtd #pre` / `#task #gtd #post` run renders as one teal sunrise / flag identity glyph, and every readable `[repeat:: …]` rule renders as a quiet loop glyph plus a spoken cadence (`daily`, `Mondays`, `monthly · 1st`). This works in Live Preview, reading view, and Tasks query results. Nothing changes in storage, and anything uncertain keeps its honest pill.
